goal: A developer can run skillz validate to get a static structure and security verdict for a skill, and skillz render to get Claude and Codex install variants from the one canonical source, each with a JSON report and Markdown summary under skills/<name>/.factory/

plan.goal: Static never-executing validate_skill with all REQ-002 rules, validate.json/validate.md reports and add_parser/run handlers, proven by bad-skill fixtures firing each rule with exit 1 while a clean fixture exits 0; plus capture NAME_RE fullmatch

render_skill producing Claude and Codex (agents/openai.yaml) variants under .factory/dist with render.json/render.md and add_parser/run handlers, proven to leave canonical files byte-identical; plus ci.yml read-only permissions
Wire validate and render into the skillz CLI via SUBCOMMANDS/HANDLERS with end-to-end main() tests and passing --help for both (depends on validate-skill and render-variants)
